items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is William Brower. It is October 3rd, 2010. I'm sitting with Cedar Walton and Kenneth Kimmery conducting an oral history...

ctx.x: [laughs] [Brower and Kimmery converse briefly in background – not related to Walton.]
You also, going back to your mother, she'd go along and she'd play things. She would sing the songs, so she knew the words.
